        return item

    device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
    anchors = [item["anchor"] for item in batch]
    targets = [item["target"] for item in batch]
    ctx = torch.stack([torch.LongTensor(item["ctx"]) for item in batch]).to(device)

    anchor_inputs = tokenizer(
        anchors, padding=True, truncation=True, max_length=128, return_tensors="pt"
    ).to(device)

    target_inputs = tokenizer(
        targets, padding=True, truncation=True, max_length=128, return_tensors="pt"
    ).to(device)

    batch_out = {
        "anchor_inputs": anchor_inputs,
        "target_inputs": target_inputs,
        "ctx": ctx,
    }
    if "y" in batch[0]:
        batch_out["y"] = torch.FloatTensor([item["y"] for item in batch]).to(device)
    return batch_out


class PatentModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, hierarchy_sizes):
        super().__init__()
        self.transformer = transformer.to(device)
        self.embeddings = nn.ModuleList(
            [nn.Embedding(size, 8).to(device) for size in hierarchy_sizes]
        )
        self.ctx_proj = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(32, 64), nn.ReLU()).to(device)
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(1536 + 64, 512),
            nn.LayerNorm(512),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
            nn.LayerNorm(256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(256, 1),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        ).to(device)

    def mean_pooling(self, model_output, attention_mask):
        token_embeddings = model_output.last_hidden_state
        input_mask_expanded = (
            attention_mask.unsqueeze(-1).expand(token_embeddings.size()).float()
        )
        return torch.sum(token_embeddings * input_mask_expanded, 1) / torch.clamp(
            input_mask_expanded.sum(1), min=1e-9
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        anchor_out = self.transformer(**x["anchor_inputs"])
        anchor_emb = self.mean_pooling(anchor_out, x["anchor_inputs"]["attention_mask"])

        target_out = self.transformer(**x["target_inputs"])
        target_emb = self.mean_pooling(target_out, x["target_inputs"]["attention_mask"])

        )
        ctx_emb = self.ctx_proj(ctx_emb)

        combined = torch.cat([combined_emb, ctx_emb], dim=1)

train_hierarchy = np.array(train_df["context"].apply(split_cpc).tolist())

)

)

    def __init__(self, df, context, y=None):
        self.df = df
        self.context = context
        self.y = y

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.df)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        item = {
            "anchor": self.df.iloc[idx]["anchor"],
            "target": self.df.iloc[idx]["target"],
            "ctx": self.context[idx],
        }
        if self.y is not None:
            item["y"] = self.y[idx]
        return item


def collate_fn(batch):
    anchors = [item["anchor"] for item in batch]
    targets = [item["target"] for item in batch]
    ctx = torch.stack([torch.LongTensor(item["ctx"]) for item in batch])

    anchor_inputs = tokenizer(
        anchors, padding=True, truncation=True, max_length=128, return_tensors="pt"
    )
    target_inputs = tokenizer(
        targets, padding=True, truncation=True, max_length=128, return_tensors="pt"
    )

    batch_out = {
        "anchor_inputs": anchor_inputs,
        "target_inputs": target_inputs,
        "ctx": ctx,
    }
    if "y" in batch[0]:
        batch_out["y"] = torch.FloatTensor([item["y"] for item in batch])
    return batch_out


class PatentModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, hierarchy_sizes):
        super().__init__()
        self.transformer = transformer
        self.embeddings = nn.ModuleList(
            [nn.Embedding(size, 8) for size in hierarchy_sizes]
        )
        self.ctx_proj = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(32, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.head = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(1536 + 64, 512),
            nn.LayerNorm(512),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Dropout(0.2),
            nn.Linear(512, 256),
            nn.LayerNorm(256),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(256, 1),
            nn.Sigmoid(),
        )

    def mean_pooling(self, model_output, attention_mask):
        token_embeddings = model_output.last_hidden_state
        input_mask_expanded = (
            attention_mask.unsqueeze(-1).expand(token_embeddings.size()).float()
        )
        return torch.sum(token_embeddings * input_mask_expanded, 1) / torch.clamp(
            input_mask_expanded.sum(1), min=1e-9
        )

    def forward(self, x):
        device = next(self.parameters()).device
        anchor_inputs = {k: v.to(device) for k, v in x["anchor_inputs"].items()}
        target_inputs = {k: v.to(device) for k, v in x["target_inputs"].items()}
        ctx = x["ctx"].to(device)

        anchor_out = self.transformer(**anchor_inputs)
        anchor_emb = self.mean_pooling(anchor_out, anchor_inputs["attention_mask"])

        target_out = self.transformer(**target_inputs)
        target_emb = self.mean_pooling(target_out, target_inputs["attention_mask"])

        combined_emb = torch.cat([anchor_emb, target_emb], dim=1)
        ctx_emb = torch.cat([self.embeddings[i](ctx[:, i]) for i in range(4)], dim=1)
        ctx_emb = self.ctx_proj(ctx_emb)

        combined = torch.cat([combined_emb, ctx_emb], dim=1)
        return self.head(combined).squeeze()
